title: Tip 126: No Actual Transport Order on SLI
body:
If there's no actual transport order on SLI, the required date is set for future's date, and the retailer is asking to raise a transport order.

To fix this, please ask the retailer to cancel the current call-off and re-call it off with today's date.

Once he call it off and raise the transport order, the vehicle will appear on RAV for normal vehicle registration.

Alternatively, we can raise the transport order manually after the retailer re-call it off.

But he needs to confirm the correct delivery address.

We will create it after the retailer re-call it off.
